description: Modern, high-performance headless commerce storefront built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, integrating with Shopify via Storefront API. Supports both physical and digital products with a focus on exceptional UX and visual design.

technicalStack.backend: Shopify Storefront API + Shopify Admin API
technicalStack.database: Shopify (primary) + optional PostgreSQL for custom features

stories.title: Project Foundation Setup
stories.description: Initialize Next.js 14+ project with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and essential configurations
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js project initialized with App Router
Basic folder structure created (app/, components/, lib/, types/)

stories.title: Shopify Storefront API Integration
stories.description: Set up Shopify Storefront API client with authentication and basic queries
acceptanceCriteria: Shopify Storefront API client library installed (@shopify/hydrogen or shopify-buy)
API client configured with storefront access token
GraphQL queries set up for products and collections
Type definitions created for Shopify data models
Test query successfully fetches products from Shopify
Error handling implemented for API calls

stories.title: Homepage with Featured Products
stories.description: Create an engaging homepage with hero section, featured products, and modern design
acceptanceCriteria: Responsive hero section with eye-catching design
Featured products section pulling from Shopify
Product cards with image, title, price, and hover effects

stories.title: Product Collection Pages with Search & Filter
stories.description: Build collection pages with advanced search, filtering, and sorting capabilities
acceptanceCriteria: Product grid with pagination or infinite scroll
Filter by price range, product type, tags
Filter/sort state persisted in URL params

stories.title: Individual Product Pages
stories.description: Detailed product pages with image gallery, variants, and add-to-cart
acceptanceCriteria: Image gallery with zoom and thumbnails
Variant selector (size, color, etc.) if applicable
Product description with rich text support
Add to cart button with loading state

stories.title: Shopping Cart Functionality
stories.description: Implement shopping cart with add/remove/update capabilities and persistent storage
acceptanceCriteria: Cart state management (Context API or Zustand)
Add to cart from product pages
Cart icon in header with item count badge

stories.title: Checkout Integration
stories.description: Integrate with Shopify Checkout for secure payment processing
acceptanceCriteria: Create Shopify checkout session from cart

stories.title: User Authentication System
stories.description: Implement user authentication with Shopify customer accounts
acceptanceCriteria: Login functionality with Shopify Customer API

stories.title: User Account Dashboard
stories.description: Create user dashboard for viewing orders, managing profile, and account settings

stories.title: Wishlist / Favorites Feature
stories.description: Allow users to save products to a wishlist for later purchase
acceptanceCriteria: Persist wishlist to user account (if logged in)
Move from wishlist to cart functionality

stories.title: Product Reviews & Ratings System
stories.description: Implement product review and rating functionality with moderation
acceptanceCriteria: Sort reviews by rating, date, helpfulness
Storage solution (Shopify metafields or separate DB)

stories.title: Email Notification System
stories.description: Set up transactional email system for order confirmations and updates
acceptanceCriteria: Email service integrated (Resend, SendGrid, or similar)
Webhook handlers for Shopify order events

stories.title: Custom Admin Dashboard
stories.description: Build admin panel for managing custom features beyond Shopify's admin
acceptanceCriteria: Manage site content (hero images, featured collections)

stories.title: Performance Optimization & SEO
stories.description: Optimize site performance, implement advanced SEO, and ensure accessibility
acceptanceCriteria: Image optimization with Next.js Image component
Lazy loading for images and components
Metadata API for SEO (title, description, OG tags)

technicalNotes: Use Next.js 14+ App Router for best performance and DX
All Shopify data should be fetched server-side when possible (RSC)
Implement proper caching strategy for Shopify API calls
Use Shopify Storefront API for public data, Admin API for privileged operations
Consider using Shopify Hydrogen UI components for faster development
Implement proper error boundaries and fallbacks
Use environment variables for all sensitive configuration
Each story should be completed with passing tests before marking passes: true
Break down any story that becomes too large during implementation
designPrinciples: Modern, sleek aesthetic with clean typography
High-quality product imagery with zoom/multiple views
Consistent color palette and spacing (Tailwind config)
Fast page transitions and loading states
Visual hierarchy that guides user attention
